explication: Supabase is a Postgres development platform combining a hosted dashboard with open-source database, API, authentication, realtime, storage, and functions services. A principal workflow is a developer using Studio to inspect or manage a project, with database-query hooks issuing SQL through the platform’s data layer. The README documents the backend service roles and their relationships; sampled Studio files show query and reporting behavior. Other Studio feature wiring is not sampled, so those connections are not inferred.
